paraphrase: Prince Abhaya reports that Pūraṇa Kassapa says there is no cause or condition for not knowing and not seeing, nor for knowing and seeing. The Buddha shows the hindrances as the cause of not knowing and the awakening factors as the cause of knowing.
notes: Reported by an opponent: Prince Abhaya (SN 46.56, Buddhist Pali canon). Section refs = SuttaCentral (bilara) segmentation, checked in the local e-text.
